// Pools share the list with +16 on both size fields, so house and pool sizes must stay under 16 m.
function packFloors42(st,buildings,pools=[]){let k=0;for(const [b,flag] of [...buildings.map(b=>[b,0]),...pools.map(p=>[p,16])]){if(k>=58)break;const x0=Math.round(b.x),z0=Math.round(b.z),w=Math.round(b.w),d=Math.round(b.d);if(w<1||d<1||w>15||d>15||x0<-96||z0<-96)continue;const o=3980+(k>>1)*4+(k&1)*2;st[o]=(x0+96)*32+w+flag;st[o+1]=(z0+96)*32+d+flag;k++;}return k;}
